about: Prompts for the blind-router check of the Phaser skills' descriptions. `expect` is the one skill that should be chosen; `alt` lists an acceptable second choice for a genuine overlap; `term` is a regular expression that must appear in the expected skill's description (set only where a description was edited to carry a trigger, so it cannot lose it unnoticed). Used by tests/phaser-routing-prompts.test.mjs and, by hand, to score two blind routers.

prompts.text: Fade out of the title scene and into the level scene, passing the chosen character along, then drop the title scene.
My scene.transition call returns false and the old scene keeps taking clicks while the new one fades in.
Script a cutscene with timed dialogue, a camera pan and a sound cue, and let the player skip it.
Pause and resume a Timeline cutscene when the pause menu opens.
After I skip the cutscene a tween step inside it is left half way.
In my hand-stepped test the tween step of a timeline never moves, though its other steps fire.
Particles should swirl toward a black hole in the middle of the screen.
A gravity well I added to an emitter does nothing until I raise something; what are its defaults?
Particles pulled by a well fly straight past it instead of settling.
Fade a spark emitter from red to blue over its life with an ease curve.
Lit sprites with a normal map should shade their own dark crevices.
I called setSelfShadow on one sprite and every lit sprite changed.
Posterise the whole screen to a limited retro palette.
A pixelated mosaic transition that keeps the art's original colours.
Recolour the whole game through a brightness ramp for a palette swap.
Does Pixelate(8) make blocks eight pixels wide?
My pixel art looks soft at camera zoom 3.5; should I use smoothPixelArt or pixelArt?
A blur followed by a blocky filter ends up blocky, but the other order ends up blurry; which order should I use?
Share one AudioContext between Phaser's music and agent-beeps live sound effects.
My beeps live cue keeps playing when I mute the game.
Make the screen pulse with the music.
I added the analyser from Phaser's audio guide and the game got louder.
Pick among four exported variants of a pickup sound without repeating the last one.
Loop only the bridge of a song file by playing a region of it.
Start a new Phaser 4 game: pin the version, write the config and set up Vite.
Every scene restart adds another listener and the memory keeps growing.
Bullets tunnel through thin walls at high speed.
Keys stay stuck after I Alt-Tab away and back.
A DOM text field fights the canvas and the menu cannot be reached from the keyboard.
Prove in CI that restarting a level does not leak textures or listeners.
A tile layer draws in the wrong place and paints empty cells.
A tween ignores game.step in my test.
Two of our Phaser games need the same dialog system and the same playbot.
A blur on my sprite is clipped at the sprite's bounds.
Sound is silent until the first click and stops when the tab is hidden.
A flashlight cone of light that follows the player in a top-down game.
Which engine should an agent-built small 2D game use?
Wire a useFrame loop beside React state in a three.js game.
A thin-instanced mesh draws at the origin in Babylon.js.
Bring an agent-sprites atlas into a Godot project and say what was verified.
Add a GPU post-effect shader to our own canvas renderer.
